generic_desc: The darkness conceals the room entirely. Water trickles somewhere nearby, its quiet tapping interrupted by the occasional drip striking stone. The air is cold and damp. Beneath your feet, the floor feels uneven, and the ceiling above is beyond your vision, except for the faints sliver of peaking light above you.

Faint light filters down from somewhere overhead, barely separating the darkness into shapes. The walls rise around you, their surfaces indistinguishable from the shadows gathered along their edges. There are faint shadows in the center of the floor resembling what looks like a grate or drain.
examine_desc: It's too dark to examine anything right now.

I run my eyes over what little I can see. The walls are rough-cut stone, damp with age, their surfaces uneven beneath my hands. The floor is little more than the same cold stone that I've been resting against. There is no furniture, no obvious fixture, and no visible way out at ground level. Above me, the pale light comes through a solid barrier set into the stone.
look_desc: I am completely incapable. It's way too dark.

You strain to see through the darkness. The stone walls are close around you, rough and uneven, but their edges quickly disapear into blackness. Above, a faint pale light filters through a narrow gap. You still cannot make out what lies beyond it. There is nothing else you can clearly see.
world_map.smell_desc: There is the smell of a very old mold. it is both slightly repelling, while being just as awkwardly entrancing.
world_map.sound_desc: You hear faint echoes of.. something, from above you.. muffled. an unsettling drip from the darkness.
world_map.taste_desc: You can taste the acridness in the air.
world_map.touch_desc: The stones of this cell are rough, cold, and damp.
world_map.near_room_info: This room is utterly in darkness.
